anomalies.impact: Tying the transceivers' two ground domains together defeats galvanic isolation, allowing ground-potential differences and common-mode disturbances on the CAN side to couple into the board.

parsed.summary: The CAN transceivers’ primary and bus-side ground pins are all tied to the same GND net. This contradicts the specified isolated CAN interfaces and defeats their galvanic isolation.
